routes.name: identify-original-and-weighted-test-classes
routes.reason: The admissible bounded Lipschitz F=-abs(x)/(1+abs(x)) gives an original smooth compact test with a weighted generator jump, so the weighted test domain cannot be identified with the original one.

C9000356.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 356 (Gigli’s characterization of Alexandrov curvature.; papers: Gigli’s distributional curvature characterization of Alexandrov spaces; Weak Hessian bounds along every geodesic in RCD spaces; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/356.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_W356_ORIGINAL_CORE.statement: Original compact test core, heat regularization, and Lipschitz-multiplier Bochner calculus.

C_W356_GENERATOR.statement: Bounded Lipschitz reweighting preserves D(Delta) and its graph topology, with L=Delta+Gamma(V,.).

C_W356_RESOLVENT.statement: A bounded member of D(L) with bounded L is globally Lipschitz, using only the original heat resolvent.

C_W356_CORE_BE.statement: The distributional Hessian hypothesis gives the correctly signed weighted core Bochner inequality.

C_W356_GRAPH_CLOSURE.statement: The three-term graph form extends continuously to D(L) and then to the full AGS BE domain.

C_W356_CONSTANT_RCD.statement: AGS Theorems 3.9, 3.14 and 4.17 yield the weighted RCD(inf k,infinity) bootstrap with the same metric.

C_W356_VARIABLE_CD.statement: Proposition weight:variable-cd: exp(lambda F)m satisfies CD(K-lambda G,infinity) for every lambda>0.

C_W356_LOCALIZATION.statement: Shrinking endpoint balls and the large-lambda entropy inequality recover every prescribed strict interior subsegment.

C_W356_EVERY_GEODESIC.statement: Theorem weight:every-geodesic: (F o sigma)'' <= length(sigma)^2 G o sigma in distributions for every minimizing sigma.

C_W356_FORMAL_CORE.statement: Abstract real inner-product-space Bochner graph-form closure and the energy-to-gradient convergence estimate, with exact scalar cancellations; not the full RCD theorem.

C_W356_CLASS_OBSTRUCTION.statement: An admissible bounded Lipschitz, non-L2 F on the infinite-measure line can satisfy the weak Hessian hypothesis while an original compact test function has a non-Sobolev weighted Laplacian. This confirms the manuscript warning, not a manuscript refutation.

C_G356_FORWARD.statement: Main-manuscript Alexandrov-to-distributional-curvature implication; outside this bounded analytic mission.

C_G356_INDEX.statement: Main-manuscript heat:index and its heat-regularized index estimates; outside this bounded analytic mission.

C_G356_HESSIAN.statement: Main-manuscript frames:hessian and pathwise-frame arguments; outside this bounded analytic mission.

C_G356_COMPARISON.statement: Modified-distance functions and local-to-global comparison finish the main-manuscript reverse implication.

C_G356_CHARACTERIZATION.statement: Main equivalence with exact H^n and the original global test classes; not certified by the companion bridge alone.
